entities.summary: Isac Viana Santos is a Brazilian professional volleyball player. He is a member of the Brazil national team, a silver medallist at the 2018 World Championship and the 2019 World Cup winner. At the professional club level, he plays for the Indonesian team, Jakarta STIN BIN.
